intel_predictive.no_accuracy: Nothing measured yet. Accuracy appears once a horizon has passed.

settings.title: Prediction settings
settings.failure_horizon_days_hint: How far ahead breakdown risk is estimated.
settings.failure_risk_threshold_hint: 0–1; at or above it a warning and a maintenance recommendation are raised.
settings.history_months_hint: Order history the forecasts learn from.
settings.min_history_months_hint: With less, no figure is given.
settings.yield_window_orders_hint: Completed orders per product used for yield.
settings.regulated_hint: Predictions from a model version nobody has validated are then shown as unvalidated and open no risk case on their own.

maintenance.title: Predictive maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: The chance of a breakdown in the next {days} days, per machine, from breakdown history and sensors where there are any.
maintenance.safety: Predictions only. Nothing here stops, holds, releases or adjusts a machine, and a low figure is not proof that a machine is safe to run: machines stay under the plant's validated control systems and safety rules.
maintenance.no_sensors: No sensor readings on this machine: the figure rests on history.
maintenance.no_cost_data: Not enough cost data to compare.
maintenance.empty: No machine has been assessed yet. Machines are those linked to a work centre.
maintenance.accuracy_hint: Assessments whose horizon has passed are checked against the breakdowns that happened: {failed} broke down, {ok} did not.
maintenance.nameplate_now: On record: {a} A rated, {v} V nominal.

quality.title: Process quality and yield
quality.subtitle: Yield trends, defect patterns, supplier quality and batch variation per product, with what they cost.
quality.restriction: These predictions never replace an inspection, laboratory test, certification or quality disposition. Nothing is released because it is predicted to pass; failed inspections stay in the existing quality and concession workflow. In regulated manufacturing, validate the model before relying on it.
quality.no_variables: No process readings on enough orders to compare.
quality.not_cause: Association is a lead for investigation, not proof of cause.
quality.empty: No manufactured product has production history yet.
quality.no_lots: No lot-traced issues in the window.
quality.association_note: Association, not cause: these say where to look (lot, method, training, conditions), never who is to blame.

forecasts.title: Demand forecasts
forecasts.subtitle: Statistical forecasts per product, customer and family, against confirmed orders, with their accuracy and material shortage risk.
forecasts.not_commitment: A forecast is never a sales commitment or a production order. It is shown beside confirmed orders, never added to them; turning one into a planning forecast makes a draft that the planning approval decides.
forecasts.insufficient: Only {n} month(s) of history; {min} are needed before a figure is given.
forecasts.projection_hint: Projected stock takes the larger of forecast (or scenario) and confirmed orders each month, never both.
forecasts.empty: No product has order history yet.
forecasts.families_hint: Product forecasts summed by product category.
forecasts.customers_hint: Separate forecasts for customers who take a fifth or more of a product.
forecasts.no_customers: No customer takes a large enough share of a product for its own forecast.

materials.no_plan: There is no MRP run in force. Run materials planning first; shortage risk is read from it.
materials.reserved_hint: Reserved stock is counted once, as demand from the order it is reserved for, never also taken off supply.
materials.none: Nothing in the plan is short or below safety stock.
materials.substitution_rule: Only an approved substitution is offered for use. Anything else must go through the engineering, quality and substitution approval first; nothing is proposed because its name looks similar.
materials.supplier_line: {on}% on time · {late} late open · {fail}% incoming failures · {ncr} NCR(s)

models.title: Model versions and validation
models.subtitle: For regulated manufacturing: a model version is validated by somebody other than the person who proposed it, with evidence. Until then its predictions show as unvalidated.
models.scope_label: What it is to be used for, and on what data
models.evidence_label: Evidence the decision rests on (backtest, review, sign-off reference)
